Estimate exposure moderation of the contribution

Source: R/moderation.R
pollin_moderation.Rd

Asks which exposures (e.g. honey-bee versus other-insect abundance) drive the open-minus-exclusion contribution, as treatment-by-exposure interactions. Each exposure enters through a within-between (Mundlak) decomposition: a between-unit part (the unit mean) and a within-unit part (the deviation from it). The within-unit treatment-by-exposure coefficient is robust to any unit-level confounder – observed or not, including an unrecorded genotype – because it is identified from variation that occurs within the unit, where the confounder is constant. The between-unit part is reported but flagged as confounder-vulnerable. Adjustment covariates enter as fixed effects.

Usage

pollin_moderation(x, outcome, exposures = NULL, family = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A pollin_design() object whose data declare exposures, or a deprecated pollin_spec() object with exposures set.

outcome

Single outcome to model.

exposures

Exposures to use. NULL (the default) uses every declared exposure.

family

Optional glmmTMB family (chosen from the outcome's values if missing).

...

Passed to glmmTMB::glmmTMB().

Value

An object of class pollin_moderation with a tidy table of the treatment-by-exposure terms (each tagged within or between), FDR-adjusted across the within terms, and the fitted model in fit.

Details

From a pollin_design(), the unit of the split is the design's slope unit (with the unit levels outside it), or the outermost unit when the design carries no slope; the treatment reference level is the excluded arm, or the open arm when the design has no excluded arm. A deprecated pollin_spec() is still accepted and splits on its latent_unit.

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1)
site <- rep(paste0("s", seq_len(14L)), each = 20L)
trt <- rep(rep(c("Cage", "Open"), each = 10L), 14L)
bees <- rep(rpois(14L, 8), each = 20L) + rpois(280L, 1)
y <- rpois(length(trt), exp(1.6 + 0.3 * (trt == "Open") +
                            0.02 * bees * (trt == "Open")))
d <- data.frame(y = y, trt = trt, Site = site, bees = bees)
pd <- pollin_data(d, "y", "trt", unit = "Site", exposures = "bees")
ds <- pollin_design(pd, c(excluded = "Cage", open = "Open"), "multi_site")
pollin_moderation(ds, outcome = "y")
#> <pollin_moderation>  outcome: y  (treatment x exposure)
#>                  term    estimate  std.error    p.value            component
#>   trtOpen:bees_within -0.11348610 0.04948954 0.02184036      within (robust)
#>  trtOpen:bees_between  0.08148486 0.04938641 0.09895419 between (vulnerable)
#>       p.fdr
#>  0.02184036
#>          NA
# }
